title: gwBenchmarks: Stress-Testing LLM Agents on High-Precision Gravitational Wave Astronomy
abstract: arXiv:2605.11269v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern gravitational wave astronomy relies on modeling tasks that often require months of graduate-level effort, including building fast waveform surrogates from expensive numerical relativity simulations, modeling orbital dynamics of black holes, fitting merger remnant properties and constructing template banks. These problems demand extreme precision to support detection and parameter inference, with state-of-the-art models achieving $\lesssim 10^{-4}$ relative error. We study whether state-of-the-art LLM coding agents can perform such end-to-end scientific modeling, where success requires constructing models with stringent accuracy criteria and reasoning about physical systems. We introduce gwBenchmarks, a suite of eight tasks grounded in gravitational wave analytic calculations and numerical simulations collectively representing over $10^8$ core-hours of compute. translated_title: gwBenchmarks：对LLM智能体在高精度引力波天文学上的压力测试
translated_abstract: 现代引力波天文学依赖于通常需要数月研究生水平努力的建模任务，包括从昂贵的数值相对论模拟中构建快速波形代理模型、对黑洞轨道动力学进行建模、拟合并合遗迹性质以及构建模板库。这些问题需要极高的精度以支持探测和参数推断，最先进的模型达到了约小于10^-4的相对误差。我们研究最先进的LLM编程智能体能否执行此类端到端的科学建模任务，其成功需要构建满足严格精度标准的模型并对物理系统进行推理。我们提出了gwBenchmarks，这是一个包含八个任务的基准测试套件，这些任务基于引力波解析计算和数值模拟，总共代表了超过10^8核心小时的计算量。这些任务涵盖插值、回归和高维
tldr: 该论文提出了gwBenchmarks基准测试套件，通过八个基于引力波解析计算和数值模拟、代表超过10^8核心小时计算量的高精度任务，评估LLM编程智能体能否完成需要极端精度的端到端科学建模工作。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces gwBenchmarks, a suite of eight high-precision tasks grounded in gravitational wave analytic calculations and numerical simulations representing over 10^8 core-hours of compute, to stress-test whether LLM coding agents can perform end-to-end scientific modeling with stringent accuracy requirements.
